Pull Request Revisions

RevisionDescription
r9
Uncommented and implemented appendIfNodeHasIP functionAdded implementation for appendIfNodeHasIP function to add node IPs to IPSet for single or Tailscale IPs
r8
Removed commented IPv6 ranges, logicRemoved commented out IPv6 address ranges and commented out node IP resolution logic with TODO markers in policy test and types files
r7
Simplified route approval test logicRemoved skipV1 flag and simplified test case running for policy manager route approval tests
r6
Removed policy v1 codeDeprecated policy v1 implementation by removing related code and comments in policy and integration test files
r5
Remove v1 policy implementation completelyComprehensive removal of the v1 policy package, including all files and references. Updated integration tests and policy-related code to use only v2 policy implementation. Simplified policy handling by removing the legacy version and associated environmental switches.
r4
ACL test source and destination modifiedUpdated ACL test sources from group to specific host, and destination from wildcard to specific host
r3
Added wildcard support for SSH aliasesUpdated SSH marshaling to support Asterix type, allowing wildcard (*) representation in SSH source and destination aliases
r2
Added JSON marshalling for policy typesImplemented custom MarshalJSON methods for multiple policy-related types to ensure proper JSON serialization with nil and empty handling
r1
Remove policy v1 implementationRemove the entire v1 policy implementation from the codebase, including all files in hscontrol/policy/v1/. Migrate integration tests and references to use the v2 policy format.
